tools.name: smartplan_list_accounts
tools.description: Shows only the account selected during login, from the authenticated account list. Read-only Smartplan Pro API.

tools.name: smartplan_get_account
tools.description: Account settings and timezone for this connection's selected account. Read-only Smartplan Pro API.

tools.name: smartplan_list_members
tools.description: One page of members for the selected account; continue with next_offset. Excludes contact details, photos and custom data. Read-only Smartplan Pro API.

tools.name: smartplan_get_member
tools.description: One member by ID in the selected account. Excludes contact details, photos and custom data. Read-only Smartplan Pro API.

tools.name: smartplan_list_locations
tools.description: One page of locations for the selected account; continue with next_offset. Read-only Smartplan Pro API.

tools.name: smartplan_get_location
tools.description: One location by ID in the selected account. Read-only Smartplan Pro API.

tools.name: smartplan_list_jobtypes
tools.description: One page of job roles for the selected account; continue with next_offset. Read-only Smartplan Pro API.

tools.name: smartplan_get_jobtype
tools.description: One jobtype by ID in the selected account. Read-only Smartplan Pro API.

tools.name: smartplan_list_shifts
tools.description: One page of upcoming shifts for the selected account; continue with next_offset. Date filters use the displayed start date, including shifts crossing midnight. Shift IDs change on archive/bulk edit; worklogs are historical records. Read-only Smartplan Pro API.

tools.name: smartplan_get_shift
tools.description: One shift by ID in the selected account. Date filters use the displayed start date, including shifts crossing midnight. Shift IDs change on archive/bulk edit; worklogs are historical records. Read-only Smartplan Pro API.

tools.name: smartplan_list_worklogs
tools.description: One page of recorded worklogs for the selected account; continue with next_offset. Date filters use the displayed start date, including shifts crossing midnight. Shift IDs change on archive/bulk edit; worklogs are historical records. Read-only Smartplan Pro API.

tools.name: smartplan_get_worklog
tools.description: One worklog by ID in the selected account. Date filters use the displayed start date, including shifts crossing midnight. Shift IDs change on archive/bulk edit; worklogs are historical records. Read-only Smartplan Pro API.

tools.name: smartplan_list_absences
tools.description: One page of absence dates for the selected account; continue with next_offset. Excludes absence types, reasons and notes. Read-only Smartplan Pro API.

tools.name: smartplan_get_absence
tools.description: One absence by ID in the selected account. Excludes absence types, reasons and notes. Read-only Smartplan Pro API.
